gravehound.name: Grave Hound
gravehound.senses: Smells the living 120 ft.; Passive Perception 13

id-00001.name: Hunting Howl
id-00001.desc: When it first sees the living, it howls: every adventurer who hears it gains 1 Dread (once a day).

id-00002.name: Grave Sense
id-00002.desc: It knows where every living creature within 120 feet is, light or no light.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target makes a Strength save (DC 12) or is knocked prone.

text.p: A hound of the barrow-lords, buried with its master and risen with him. Patchy fur over grey bone, eyes like coals in ash. It does not tire, and it does not lose a scent.

id-00001.name: Unfinished
id-00001.desc: When damage drops it to 0 Health, it makes a Constitution save (DC 5 + the damage) unless the damage was radiant or a critical hit; on a success it stays at 1 Health.

id-00001.name: Slam
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.

text.p: A body that got up again. It remembers nothing but the way home, and it is going there through anyone in its path.

id-00001.name: Brittle
id-00001.desc: Bludgeoning damage against it is doubled.

id-00002.name: Old Orders
id-00002.desc: It guards one place and does not leave it.

id-00001.name: Rusted Blade
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

id-00002.name: Old Bow
id-00002.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft.. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

text.p: The skeleton of a soldier still at its post, in the scraps of a uniform nobody alive remembers.

lanternwight.name: Lantern Wight
lanternwight.languages: the languages it knew in life

id-00001.name: Drinker of Light
id-00001.desc: Non-magical light within 30 feet of it gutters to dim; torches carried near it burn twice as fast.

id-00002.name: Sunlight Hurts
id-00002.desc: In sunlight it has disadvantage on attacks.

id-00001.name: Cold Hand
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Necrotic damage. The target's maximum Health drops by the same amount until a safe rest, and it gains 1 Dread.

id-00002.name: Longsword
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage.

text.p: It carries a lantern full of cold blue fire, and wherever it walks the warm light dies. Once it was a lamplighter; it is still lighting the way, to somewhere else.

id-00001.name: Light-Blind
id-00001.desc: In bright light it has disadvantage on attacks and on Perception that relies on sight.

id-00002.name: Scatter
id-00002.desc: It can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

id-00001.name: Notched Knife
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

id-00002.name: Sling
id-00002.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft.. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

text.p: Grey, thin and wide-eyed, the deep folk live where the sun never reaches and come up at night to steal. Alone they flee; in a pack they are brave.

id-00001.name: Snuff
id-00001.desc: As a bonus action, it puts out every non-magical flame within 30 feet. Once per fight.

id-00001.name: Witchfire
id-00001.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft.. Hit: 9 (2d8) Fire damage.

id-00002.name: Staff
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +1, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) Bludgeoning damage.

text.p: The deep folk hate fire, and fear those of their own who can call it. A firecaller leads by fear, and puts out your torches first.

id-00001.name: Great Club
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

text.p: Bred big by the deep folk to carry loads and break doors. It does both well.

id-00001.name: Swarm
id-00001.desc: It can enter another creature's space and squeeze through rat-sized gaps. It cannot regain Health.

id-00001.name: Bites
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 0 ft.. Hit: 7 (2d6) Piercing damage. Half as much if the swarm has half its Health or less.

text.p: A carpet of rats that have eaten well in the old tombs and want more.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage. The target makes a Constitution save (DC 11) or is poisoned for an hour.

text.p: A centipede as long as a man, black and glistening. It lives on the ceilings of old places and drops on what passes below.

palespider.name: Pale Spider
palespider.senses: Feels the web 60 ft.; Passive Perception 10

id-00001.name: Web Walker
id-00001.desc: It ignores webs and climbs anything.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage. The target makes a Constitution save (DC 11) or takes 2d8 poison damage.

id-00002.name: Web
id-00002.desc: Ranged, 30/60 ft.: a creature hit (the spider's attack against its Defense) is held fast by webbing; Strength (DC 12) to break free.

text.p: White as a corpse's hand and the size of a pony, it weaves the empty halls shut.

id-00001.name: Pack Hunter
id-00001.desc: Advantage on attacks against a creature an ally of it stands beside.

id-00001.name: Bite
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage. A target that is hit makes a Strength save (DC 11) or is knocked prone.

text.p: Grey wolves of the burned forests, thin with hunger. They follow travellers for days before they strike.

id-00001.name: Waterlogged
id-00001.desc: Resistant to fire damage. Advantage on Stealth underwater.

id-00001.name: Clutch
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 13); a grappled creature in water cannot breathe.

text.p: Swollen, pale and patient, it waits under black water for someone to lean too close.

id-00001.name: Incorporeal
id-00001.desc: It moves through walls and creatures; non-magical weapons deal half damage to it.

id-00002.name: Grief
id-00002.desc: Any adventurer who starts a turn within 10 feet of it makes a Wisdom save (DC 13) or gains 1 Dread.

id-00001.name: Withering Touch
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

text.p: The last watcher of a tower that fell: it still walks the battlements, still waiting for the relief that never came.

id-00001.name: Bog Mask
id-00001.desc: She can look like a lost child, an old woman with a lamp, or a lantern in the fog.

id-00001.name: Claws
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00002.name: Marsh Light
id-00002.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft.. Hit: 11 (2d10) Psychic damage. The target gains 1 Dread.

text.p: She leads travellers into the marsh with a light like a window, and keeps what she catches.

id-00001.name: Shortsword
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage.

id-00002.name: Light Crossbow
id-00002.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 80/320 ft.. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

text.p: Hungry, desperate and armed. Most would rather rob you than kill you, if you let them.

id-00001.name: Two Blades
id-00001.desc: It attacks twice with its sabre and once with its dagger as one action.

id-00001.name: Sabre
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

id-00002.name: Dagger
id-00002.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

text.p: A former soldier with a band of her own, a sharp mind, and debts.

id-00001.name: Faith in the Void
id-00001.desc: Advantage on saves against being frightened.

id-00001.name: Sickle
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage.

text.p: The cult of the Hollow Star believes the dark is a door, and that something waits on the other side to be let in.

id-00001.name: Oathbound
id-00001.desc: While its tower stands, Saranth rises again at dusk after it is destroyed, unless its oath-ring is taken from the tower or its bones are burned.

id-00002.name: Commander
id-00002.desc: Bone Sentinels within 30 feet of it add 2 to their attack rolls.

id-00003.name: Two Strikes
id-00003.desc: It attacks twice with its longsword as one action.

id-00001.name: Longsword
id-00001.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft.. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage. And 1d6 necrotic.

id-00002.name: Call the Watch
id-00002.desc: Once per day: two Bone Sentinels climb from the floor within 30 feet and fight at its command.

text.p: The last commander of the Empty Watchtower, who swore to hold it until relieved. Nobody came. He held it anyway.

Each creature has its Defense, Health (and the dice to roll it), speed, abilities, senses, and what it does on its turn. Its level of challenge says how dangerous it is: a party of four can usually face creatures whose challenges add up to their levels, if they are careful and have light.
Every creature in this book is in Kraken's NPC list once the book is active: drag one onto the combat tracker or the map. Its attacks roll themselves against the target's Defense.
